slug: 被逐出宗门后师尊师姐后悔终生
content_zh:
玄黄山，玉清宗，审判大厅。
“周通，你毁坏宗门重宝，可知罪否！”
“我知道你个棒槌！”
少年目光如电，此时的他，已是重生而来的绝世强者。
前世他被师弟陷害，被师尊厌恶，被师姐们视为仇人，最终还被他们联手害死。
这一世他将不念旧情，有冤报冤，有仇报仇！
问话的是一位绝美女尊，白发如瀑，冰冷高贵，此人正是他的师尊莫流苏，也是害死他的罪魁祸首之一。
他自幼无父无母，被外出历练的莫流苏带回宗门，收为弟子。
在他前面还有五个师姐，个个天赋异禀，容貌出众，一开始的时候还对他颇为照顾，但自从小师弟唐七加入之后，一切就都变了。
那唐七天资出众，心机极深，而且还有天命恩宠，很快就夺走了众人对周通的喜爱。
在那之后，师姐和师尊就视周通如敝履，对其不屑一顾。
为了挽回师尊和师姐，他曾千方百计的讨好众人，也曾试图与唐七抗争，结果却遭到了众人的无情压制。
正如今日，明明是唐七损毁了宗门重宝，却联合了四师姐和五师姐一同嫁祸给他，只是为了欣赏他百口莫辩的模样。
“放肆，你就是这么跟我说话的吗！”莫流苏的脸色立刻冷了下去。
“人证物证俱在，你不仅不承认，而且还敢对长辈无礼，实在是罪加一等，还不跪下！”
紧接着，就有一股强大的气势扑面而下，压在了周通的肩头。
“嘎吱嘎吱…”
周通身上传出了骨头摩擦的声音，他承受着巨大的压力，身体却站得挺直。
这一幕让众人惊呼，周通身上还有伤，这无异于经历了一场酷刑。
然而周通却面带冷笑，目光犀利的看着对方：“耳听为虚，明明没有物证就想要逼迫我认罪，在你眼里，我就是一个可以让人践踏的玩偶！”

“你所做的一切，都是在无底线的包庇你的好徒弟，你根本不配做我的师父！”
莫流苏神色微凝，对上了那道目光，竟然忍不住浑身一颤。
那个平日里唯唯诺诺，总想讨她欢心的周通，现在明明应该脸委屈的求她原谅才对。
一念至此，她反而更加恼火。
“你这是什么意思，难道小七和你师姐还会说谎不成？他们可不像你一样卑劣虚伪，你装成这副模样给谁看？
既然你想用不屈来表达对我的不满，那我就告诉你好了，在小七面前你什么都不是！”
莫流苏继续加大威压，将周通身上的骨头压得咯吱作响，几乎就要崩溃。
“师尊，您就饶了师兄一回吧，他可能是太害怕了，又嫉妒我总是被大家宠爱，所以才会嫁祸于我的。”
就在这时，唐七突然站了出来，假惺惺的说道。
看见此人，周通的瞳孔骤然一缩。
这家伙表面单纯，实际上却包藏祸心，修炼魔功，想要献祭天下人助他成就大道。
后来对方也真的成功了，将玉清宗满门屠戮，五个师姐被他练成傀儡，就连莫流苏也被他囚禁沦为玩物。
这些都是周通前世死后，以魂魄之身看到的场景，当时他的心中只有快意。
“小七你就是太善良了，所以才有奸人敢陷害你，你不必为他求情，今天我就要让他受到应有的惩罚。”
莫流苏脸上罕见的浮现出了一丝笑意，这是不加掩饰的偏心！
“师尊不要啊，师兄也只是一时糊涂，请您给他一个改过自新的机会！”
唐七跪在了莫流苏的面前，声情并茂的说道。
他看似是在给周通求情，却把罪名死死的按在了周通的头上。
“也罢，看在你的面子上，我就饶了这个孽障一回。”
content_en:
Xuanhuang Mountain, Jade Qingzong, Judgment Hall.
"Zhou Tong, do you think you are guilty of destroying the sect's treasure?"
"I know you're a stick!"
The young man's eyes were like lightning. At this moment, he was already a reborn powerful man.
In his previous life, he was framed by his junior brothers, hated by his master, regarded as an enemy by his senior sisters, and eventually killed by their joint forces.
In this life, he will not miss his old love, repay injustice and revenge!
The person who asked the question was a beautiful lady with white hair like a waterfall, cold and noble. This person was his master Mo Liusu and one of the culprits who killed him.
He had no father or mother since he was a child. He was brought back to the sect by Mo Liusu who was away for training and accepted as a disciple.
There are five senior sisters in front of him, all of whom are talented and outstanding in appearance. They took good care of him at the beginning, but since the junior brother Tang Qi joined, everything has changed.
Tang Qi's outstanding talent, deep scheming, and destiny's grace soon took away everyone's love for Zhou Tong.
After that, the senior sister and master regarded Zhou Tong as if he were wearing worn shoes and looked down upon him.
In order to save his master and sister, he tried every possible means to please everyone, and also tried to fight against Tang Qi, but was ruthlessly suppressed by everyone.
Just like today, it was clearly Tang Qi who destroyed the sect's treasure, but he united with the Fourth Senior Sister and the Fifth Senior Sister to frame the blame on him, just to appreciate his inability to defend himself.
"Presumptuous, is this how you talk to me!" Mo Liusu's face immediately turned cold.
"There are all the witnesses and physical evidence. Not only do you refuse to admit it, but you also dare to be rude to your elders. It's really an added crime. You still don't kneel down!"
Immediately afterwards, a powerful momentum rushed down on Zhou Tong's shoulders.
"Crunch, crunch..."
The sound of bones rubbing could be heard from Zhou Tong's body. He was under tremendous pressure, but his body stood straight.
This scene made everyone exclaim that Zhou Tong was still injured, which was tantamount to experiencing a torture.
However, Zhou Tong had a sneer on his face and looked at the other party with sharp eyes: "Hearing what you heard is false. You want to force me to plead guilty even though there is no physical evidence. In your eyes, I am just a doll that can be trampled on!"
"Everything you have done is to protect your good apprentice without any bottom line. You are not worthy of being my master at all!"
Mo Liusu's expression condensed slightly, and when he met that gaze, he couldn't help but tremble.
Zhou Tong, who was usually submissive and always wanted to please her, should now beg her for forgiveness with an aggrieved face.
The thought made her even more angry.
"What do you mean? Do Xiaoqi and your senior sister still lie? They are not as despicable and hypocritical as you. Who do you pretend to be like this for?
Since you want to use unyielding to express your dissatisfaction with me, then I will tell you, you are nothing in front of Xiaoqi! "
Mo Liusu continued to increase the pressure, causing Zhou Tong's bones to creak under the pressure, and he was almost about to collapse.
"Master, please spare my senior brother for once. He may be too scared and jealous that I am always favored by everyone, so he put the blame on me."
At this moment, Tang Qi suddenly stood up and said hypocritically.
Seeing this person, Zhou Tong's pupils suddenly shrank.
This guy is innocent on the surface, but he actually harbors evil intentions, practices magic skills, and wants to sacrifice the people of the world to help him achieve greatness.
Later, the other party really succeeded and slaughtered the entire Yuqing Sect. Five senior sisters were trained into puppets by him, and even Mo Liusu was imprisoned and turned into a plaything by him.
These were the scenes Zhou Tong saw in his soul after his death in his previous life. At that time, he only felt happy.
"Xiao Qi, you are too kind, that's why a traitor dared to frame you. You don't have to plead for him. Today I will let him get the punishment he deserves."
A rare smile appeared on Mo Liusu's face. This was undisguised partiality!
"Master, please don't. Senior brother is just confused for a moment. Please give him a chance to change his ways."! "
Tang Qi knelt in front of Mo Liusu and spoke passionately.
He seemed to be pleading for Zhou Tong, but he firmly pinned the accusation on Zhou Tong's head.
"Forget it, for your sake, I will spare this evil obstacle. "
